reference_pathology_confirmed_diagnosis.requiredIf: This field is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
reference_pathology_confirmed_diagnosis.description: Indicate whether the pathological diagnosis was confirmed by a (central) reference pathologist.

reference_pathology_confirmed_tumour_pre.requiredIf: This field is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
reference_pathology_confirmed_tumour_pre.description: Indicate whether the (central) reference pathologist confirmed the presence of tumour in the specimen.

tumour_grading_system.requiredIf: This field is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
tumour_grading_system.description: Specify the tumour grading system used to assess the description of a tumour based on how abnormal the tumour cells and the tumour tissue look under a microscope. Tumour grade is an indicator of how quickly a tumour is likely to grow.
validationInfo: WHO grading system for CNS tumours

tumour_grade.requiredIf: This field depends on the selected tumour_grading_system, and is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
tumour_grade.description: Grade of the tumour as assigned by the reporting tumour_grading_system.

percent_tumour_cells_range.requiredIf: This field is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
percent_tumour_cells_range.description: Select the range representing the percent of tumour cells compared to the number of total cells in a specimen. (Reference: NCIt: C159484)

percent_tumour_cells_measurement_method.requiredIf: This field is only required if the specimen is a tumour.
percent_tumour_cells_measurement_method.description: Indicate method used to measure percent_tumour_cells.

specimen_storage.description: Indicate the method of long term storage for specimen that were not extracted freshly or immediately cultured.

specimen_processing.description: Indicate the technique used to process specimen.
validationInfo: Cryopreservation of live cells in liquid nitrogen

specimen_laterality.description: For cancer in a paired organ, indicate the side on which the specimen was obtained. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 2007875)

date_of_diagnosis.description: Date that the donor was first diagnosed with cancer. This date should be based on the earliest diagnosis.

cancer_type_code.description: The code to represent the cancer type using the WHO ICD-10 code (https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en) classification.

primary_site.description: The text term used to describe the primary site of disease, as categorized by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O). This categorization groups cases into general categories.
validationInfo: Bones, joints and articular cartilage of limbs
Bones, joints and articular cartilage of other and unspecified sites
Connective, subcutaneous and other soft tissues
Other and ill-defined sites in lip, oral cavity and pharynx
Other and ill-defined sites within respiratory system and intrathoracic organs
Other and unspecified female genital organs
Other and unspecified major salivary glands
Other and unspecified male genital organs
Other and unspecified parts of biliary tract
Other and unspecified parts of mouth
Other and unspecified parts of tongue
Other endocrine glands and related structures
Peripheral nerves and autonomic nervous system
Spinal cord, cranial nerves, and other parts of central nervous system

basis_of_diagnosis.description: Indicate the most valid basis of how the primary diagnosis was identified. Terms are ordered in hierarchical order according to IACR guidelines, with the term at the top of the list ("Histology of primary tumour") being the more valid basis. If more than one diagnosis technique was used, select the most valid basis.

laterality.description: For cancer in a paired organ, indicate the side of the body on which the primary tumour or cancer first developed at the time of primary diagnosis. (Reference caDSR CDE ID 827)

clinical_tumour_staging_system.requiredIf: This field is only required if pathological staging is not submitted.
clinical_tumour_staging_system.description: Indicate the tumour staging system used to stage the cancer at the time of primary diagnosis (prior to treatment).
validationInfo: International Neuroblastoma Risk Group Staging System

clinical_t_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
clinical_t_category.description: The code to represent the extent of the primary tumour (T) based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

clinical_n_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
clinical_n_category.description: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the regional lymph node (N) involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

clinical_m_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
clinical_m_category.description: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the extent of the distant metastasis (M) for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual. MX is NOT a valid category and cannot be assigned.

clinical_stage_group.requiredIf: This field is dependent on the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system. Refer to the documentation for Tumour Staging Classifications
clinical_stage_group.description: Stage group of the tumour, as assigned by the reporting clinical_tumour_staging_system, that indicates the overall prognostic tumour stage (ie. Stage I, Stage II, Stage III etc.).

pathological_tumour_staging_system.requiredIf: This field is only required if  clinical staging was not submitted.
pathological_tumour_staging_system.description: Specify the tumour staging system used to assess the cancer associated with the primary diagnosis. Pathological classification is based on the clinical stage information (acquired before treatment) and supplemented/modified by operative findings and pathological evaluation of the resected specimen.
validationInfo: International Neuroblastoma Risk Group Staging System

pathological_t_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
pathological_t_category.description: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by the size or contiguous extension of the primary tumour (T), according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

pathological_n_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
pathological_n_category.description: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by whether or not the cancer has reached nearby lymph nodes (N), according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

pathological_m_category.requiredIf: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system
pathological_m_category.description: The code to represent the stage of cancer defined by whether there are distant metastases (M), meaning spread of cancer to other parts of the body, according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

pathological_stage_group.requiredIf: This field is only required if clinical staging was not submitted.
pathological_stage_group.description: Specify the tumour stage, based on pathological_tumour_staging_system, used to assess the cancer at the time the tumour specimen was resected.

psa_level.description: A laboratory test that measures the amount of prostate-specific antigen (PSA) found in the blood. PSA is a protein made by the prostate gland. The amount of PSA may be higher in men who have prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), or infection or inflammation of the prostate (Reference NCIt C17634). Indicate level of PSA in ng/mL.

ca125.description: Indicate the amount of cancer antigen 125 present in a blood serum sample in U/ml (References: NCIt C141277, LOINC: 10334-1)

cea.description: Indicate the amount of carcinoembryonic antigen present in a serum sample in ng/ml (References NCIt C157252, LOINC 2039-6).

er_status.description: Indicate the expression of estrogen receptor (ER). (Reference: NAACCR 3827)

er_percent_positive.description: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of cells staining estrogen receptor positive by immunohistochemistry (IHC). (Reference: NAACCR: 3826)

pr_status.description: Indicate the expression of progesterone receptor (PR). (Reference: NAACCR 3915)

pr_percent_positive.description: Indicate a value, in decimals, that represents the percent of cells staining progesterone receptor positive by immunohistochemistry (IHC). (Reference: NAACCR: 3914)

her2_ihc_status.description: Indicate the expression of human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2) assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC). (Reference: AJCC 8th Edition, Chapter 48)

her2_ish_status.description: Indicate the gene copy number of human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2) assessed by in situ hybridization (ISH). (Reference: NAACCR: 3854)

hpv_ihc_status.description: Indicate the expression of Human papillomavirus (HPV) p16 as assessed by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

hpv_pcr_status.description: Indicate HPV status determined by PCR. (Reference NCIt: C159326)

comorbidity_type_code.requiredIf: This field is required because it should have a cancer or non-cancer ICD-10 code. This field is marked '' because it depends on the value of the `prior_malignancy` field. Both these fields will need to be consistent. If `prior_malignancy` is `Yes`, then an ICD-10 code related to cancer is expected in this field. If `prior_malignancy` is `No`, then an ICD-10 code related to a non-cancer condition is expected in this field.
comorbidity_type_code.description: Indicate the code for the comorbidity using the WHO ICD-10 code classification (https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en).

validationInfo.message:
Values must meet the regular expression
^[A-Z][0-9]{2}(.[0-9]{1,3}[A-Z]{0,1})?$

Examples:
E10, C50.1, I11, M06,

comorbidity_treatment_status.requiredIf: This field should only be submitted if patient has been indicated to have a comorbidity.
comorbidity_treatment_status.description: Indicate if the patient is being treated for the comorbidity (this includes prior malignancies).

comorbidity_treatment.requiredIf: This field should only be submitted if patient has been indicated to have a comorbidity.
comorbidity_treatment.description: Indicate treatment details for the comorbidity (this includes prior malignancies).

validationInfo.message:
Values must meet the regular expression
^[A-Za-z0-9\-\._]{1,64}$

submitter_donor_id.description: Unique identifier for the donor, assigned by the data provider.

validationInfo.message:
Values must meet the regular expression
^[A-Za-z0-9\-\._]{1,64}$

Examples:
90234, BLD_donor_89, AML-90

tobacco_smoking_status.description: Indicate donor's self-reported smoking status and history. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2181650)
validationInfo: Current reformed smoker, duration not specified
Lifelong non-smoker (<100 cigarettes smoked in lifetime)

tobacco_type.requiredIf: This field cannot be submitted if tobacco_smoking_status is "Not applicable", "Smoking history not documented" or "Lifelong non-smoker (<100 cigarettes smoked in lifetime)"
tobacco_type.description: Indicate the type(s) of tobacco used by donor. (Reference: NCIt CDE C177629)

pack_years_smoked.requiredIf: This field cannot be submitted if tobacco_smoking_status is "Not applicable", "Smoking history not documented" or "Lifelong non-smoker (<100 cigarettes smoked in lifetime)"
pack_years_smoked.description: This field applies to cigarettes. Indicate the smoking intensity in Pack Years, where the number of pack years is defined as the number of cigarettes smoked per day times (x) the number of years smoked divided (/) by 20. (Reference: caDSR CDE ID 2955385)
